entries.title: Migrated notification system to Bash
entries.body: Replaced the Python-based sensor/notify architecture with simple, single-purpose Bash listener scripts. No more plugins, engines, or personality layers.

entries.title: Rofi menu system refactored
entries.body: Unified rofi scripts under a single submenu theme, removed duplicate .rasi files and dead lib/init.sh dependencies.

entries.title: New main menu
entries.body: One launcher for WiFi, Bluetooth, Audio, Music, Clipboard, Screenshots, Screen Recorder, Wallpaper, Bookmarks, Keyboard Layout, Pomodoro, Emoji, Kill Process, and Reload.

entries.title: Waybar modules cleaned up
entries.body: Fixed broken Bluetooth, Pacman and AUR modules. Added a live Pomodoro module.

entries.title: New .local/bin structure
entries.body: Rebuilt battery, brightness, bluetooth, media, volume, wifi, usb and weather listeners as standalone Bash scripts, each with one job.
